summary: @servicetitan/va-mfe-loader ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at pinned version 1.3.13, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style rotated string-array dispatcher, `_0xNNNN` identifiers, wrapped-function object dispatch). Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time solely to execute a large opaque bundle bypasses Node-based tooling and hides the payload's behavior from review. The published `dist/` is a small benign-looking React component that imports `@servicetitan/web-components` and exports `VaMfeLoader`, unrelated to the preinstall behavior — a cover facade. The `@servicetitan/*` scope and component name mimic the ServiceTitan organization's packages, consistent with scope impersonation to trick developers into installing the dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
